sourceText:
Karoun Dairies Feta Pizza
By: Genesis Lopez
Published: Thursday, July 21, 2011 - 3:03pm

Ingredients




2 medium Mediterranean flat breads
1 jar julienned sun dried tomatoes
1 cup Karoun Mozzerella cheese, shredded
1/2 cup crumbled Karoun Mediterranean Basket Feta with Sun Dried Tomatoes& Fresh Thyme leaves to taste
4 medium plum tomatoes, halved
2 tablespoons olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced

Preparation

1 Sprinkle julienned sundried tomatoes and shredded Karoun mozzarella over Mediterranean flat bread.  Top with tomato halves and Karoun’s Mediterranean Basket Feta. 2 Combine olive oil and garlic.  Brush tomato slices with oil mixture. 3 Bake for about 10 minutes until cheese melts and pizza is heated through.  Let stand 5 minutes.  Top with fresh thyme and serve.
